Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Rustic 100% Top Grain Leather Decorative Throw Pillow, Badlands Saddle
Colors: Badlands Saddle
Materials: Leather
This handsome, sturdy leather pillow will add style and texture to a couch or chair. The rich 100% top grain leather in a saddle color gives it an outdoorsy, western flair. Beautiful natural markings in the hide make each pillow unique. 19"x 19" Full grain leather Removable polyester fiber-filled insert included Pillow cover features a zipper closure Brush, vacuum or spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
